title: Does wheat yield more after a pulse?
question: Within a town, in the open NVT deposit under provider management, how much more does wheat yield after a pulse than after a cereal?

data.name: Australian National Variety Trials, wheat (open compilation)
data.description: 28902 wheat variety means from 1022 trials near 169 towns, 2008 to 2018
data.citation: Newman, S. J. and Furbank, R. T. (2021). A multiple species, continent-wide, million-phenotype agronomic plant dataset. Scientific Data, 8, 116. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-021-00898-8. Author correction: Scientific Data 9, 437 (2022), https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-022-01536-7, which states that GRDC did not authorise or quality-control the deposit.
data.unit_label: wheat trial (one paddock near a named town in one year)
data.place: Australia; regions north, south, west; 169 towns

warnings.text: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred
warnings.window: after the L_proxymix manifest (23:04:09.790) and before the L_kernR manifest (23:04:12.661)
warnings.source: kernR estimate_propensity(method = "logistic") fits glm(family = binomial()) for the propensity weights, on the full sample and on each of 200 bootstrap replicates; one of these fits separated some trials. The tool bounds every propensity to 0.05 to 0.95 before weighting, so no weight is unbounded.

by_solutions.what: Reference arm is wheat after wheat only; wheat, barley or triticale together is a sensitivity
by_solutions.consequence: fewer reference trials (125 wheat after wheat against 137 cereal), a cleaner contrast

by_solutions.what: Town is a fixed effect in every within-town lens
by_solutions.consequence: only towns with both arms carry the contrast: 32 towns, 83 pulse and 59 wheat-after-wheat trials

by_solutions.what: crop2 by multiple imputation at trial level, m = 20
by_solutions.consequence: 412 trials had crop2 unrecorded; complete case and missing category are sensitivities

by_solutions.what: Rows with a missing weather or soil covariate dropped before fitting
proxymix and kernR use crop2 imputation 1 only; the flexyBayes three-cereal sensitivity uses imputations 1 to 5
by_solutions.consequence: their intervals do not carry the imputation uncertainty of crop2

by_solutions.what: Any region, arm or species cell with fewer than 15 trials in an arm is not estimated
by_solutions.consequence: 3 cells refused: cell north x other_cereal, cell south x other_cereal, cell west x other_cereal

by_solutions.what: trigger T_interaction fired: the pulse effect changes with growing-season rain within a region
by_solutions.consequence: value 2.916 against threshold 2.394; action release; released as a candidate for a second loop, beside the primary result, which it does not change

lenses.basis: INLA, known_variance, draws stacked over m = 20
REML, weights = w, MI m = 20, Rubin
trial-level mixture uplift after within-town adjustment, imputation 1; town-cluster bootstrap, 200

lenses.contrast: pulse - wheat after wheat, marginal over trials
lenses.basis: propensity weights (logistic, cross-fitted) truncated at 0.05 and 0.95; conditioning set region, year, crop2 (imputation 1), soil, prev_season_rain, gs_rain; trial bootstrap 200
lenses.note: Its own estimand: a propensity-weighted difference over trials, not within town, never averaged with the other lenses. The full-sample estimate is -0.30 t/ha; the median of its 200 bootstrap replicates is -0.08 t/ha, and 10% of the replicates lie below the full-sample estimate, so the interval is not centred on it.

agreement.rule: location only: every within-town lens (asreml, lme4, proxymix) within 0.25 t/ha of the flexyBayes estimate; and the C0 ladder: asreml and lme4 treatment contrasts within 0.02 t/ha unweighted and weighted, flexyBayes posterior means within 0.2 posterior SD of the REML estimate. A spread difference alone never fails the rule. quorum's status with its default thresholds is reported, not used.

discoveries.statement: Within region south, the pulse effect on wheat changes by 0.26 t/ha per 100 mm of growing-season rain (90% interval 0.11 to 0.41; interaction)

triggers.what: the real table differs from the clone in levels, missing counts, ranges or sizes
triggers.rehearsal_plant: clone copy with every Faba Bean predecessor row removed (a level of crop1_species absent, and row, trial and missing counts changed)

triggers.what: the pulse effect differs between regions
triggers.rehearsal_plant: pulse effect by region: north -0.2, south 0.4, west 1.0 t/ha (SD 0.6 around 0.4) against a common 0.4

triggers.what: the pulse effect changes with growing-season rain within a region
triggers.rehearsal_plant: pulse effect 0.4 + 0.3 t/ha per 100 mm of growing-season rain centred within region, all regions

triggers.what: the pulse effect rises then falls across growing-season rain
triggers.rehearsal_plant: pulse effect 0.4 + 1.0 x (1 - ((x - mid) / half)^2) in growing-season rain centred within region, x over the 5th to 95th percentile of pulse trials; silent on a rise to a plateau of the same 1.0 t/ha height and on the common effect
triggers.rehearsal_runs: revu_rain (fire expected); plateau_rain (silent expected); none (silent expected)

triggers.what: the pulse effect falls then rises across growing-season rain
triggers.rehearsal_plant: pulse effect 0.4 - 1.0 x (1 - ((x - mid) / half)^2) in growing-season rain centred within region
triggers.rehearsal_runs: u_rain (fire expected); revu_rain (silent expected); plateau_rain (silent expected); none (silent expected)

triggers.what: one town moves the pulse estimate by more than one standard error
triggers.rehearsal_plant: a further 3 t/ha on the pulse trials of the town carrying the most pulse and wheat-after-wheat trials

triggers.what: trial-level residuals are better described by a mixture than by one normal
triggers.rehearsal_plant: trial effects from a two-class mixture: 85% N(0, 0.6^2), 15% N(-2.5, 0.6^2) t/ha

triggers.what: the pulse effect rises then falls across another covariate
triggers.rehearsal_plant: pulse effect 0.4 + 1.5 x (1 - ((x - mid) / half)^2) in mean maximum temperature (gs_tmax), x over the 5th to 95th percentile of pulse trials; silent on a rise to a plateau of the same 1.5 t/ha height and on the common effect
triggers.rehearsal_runs: revu_tmax_h1.5 (fire expected); plateau_tmax_h1.5 (silent expected); none (silent expected)

triggers_removed.what: the lenses' 90% intervals differ in width (widest over narrowest)
triggers_removed.reason: Removed before the seal: no threshold separated a planted spread from the unplanted clones. Agreement is judged on location only.
